gherkin.scenario: Add a new department with allowance
given: I am logged in as an administrator
when: I add a new department with Name "test"
then: I should see a success message "Changes to departments were saved"
The department "test" should be in the list with allowance 10

gherkin_acceptance_criteria: The page should display "Changes to departments were saved"
The department "test" should be visible in the departments list
The allowance should be set to 10
